meaning:
πυνθώ᾽ομαι
[in LXX for דָּרַשׁ ;]
1. to inquire: with accusative of thing(s), Jhn.4:42, Act.23:20; before quæst. indir., Mat.2:4, Luk.15:25 18:36, Act.10:18 21:33; quæst. dir., Act.4:7 10:20 23:10; before παρά, with genitive of person(s), Mat.2:4, Jhn.4:52.
2. to learn by inquiry: before ὅτι, Act.23:34.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.
He called one of the servants to him, and asked what was going on.
So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”
When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them, they inquired, “By what power, or in what name, have you done this?”
